Protests Erupt Against Election Commission Chief, Demands for Resignation

Protesters in Fatehabad and Damoh burned effigies of the Chief Election Commissioner, demanding his resignation and the cancellation of an FIR. In Damoh, Congress workers were booked after burning an effigy of the Chief Election Commissioner.
